name: Kids OS v1.0.9 - Permanent Status Bar Lockdown, Ambient Auto-Brightness & Direct Kid Controls 🌸
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.9 Release Highlights

### 🧒 Dedicated OS for Kids: Zero Stock Android Exposure
- **Permanent Stock Notification Bar Lockdown**: Implemented high-priority accessibility touch barrier overlay (`TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY`, layer 301000) across the top edge. All pull-down gestures from the top are intercepted before Android SystemUI can ever receive them.
- **Instant Status Bar Collapse**: Added `StatusBarManager.collapsePanels()` reflection invocation across any system UI interactions so the stock notification shade can never expand.
- **Melody Control Center Hook**: Pulling down or tapping on the top edge seamlessly triggers our custom pastel-pink My Melody Control Center.

### ⚡ Direct Hardware Toggles (No Android Settings Screens)
- **Direct GPS/Location Toggle**: Location tile toggles GPS provider state directly using elevated `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` without ever opening Android's raw location settings screen.
- **Reliable Wi-Fi Toggle**: Instant optimistic state feedback with direct toggle and fallback through `Settings.Global`, eliminating previous delay/snapback.
- **Real-Time System Broadcast Receiver**: Connected live system broadcast listeners for Wi-Fi (`WIFI_STATE_CHANGED_ACTION`), Bluetooth (`ACTION_STATE_CHANGED`), and Location (`PROVIDERS_CHANGED_ACTION`) for instant UI synchronization.
- **Kid-Safe MelodyWifiView**: Eliminated external stock settings intents from the status bar Wi-Fi indicator.

### ☀️ Hardware Ambient Light Auto-Brightness Restored
- **Default Enabled**: Restored auto-brightness default (`true`) and ambient hardware light sensor listener.
- **Window Attribute Harmonization**: Ensured Activity window attributes delegate screen brightness to system brightness without blocking ambient light responsiveness.
- **Seekbar Drag Protection**: Programmatic slider changes no longer deactivate auto-brightness; manual mode only engages when a user intentionally touches and drags the seekbar.
